headline: Molbio Diagnostics IPO: ₹939.7 cr book-built raise comprising ₹200 cr fresh issue & ₹739.7 cr OFS, listed Aug 17 at ₹980/share (21% premium).
sum: Molbio Diagnostics raised ₹939.696 cr from a 70.26x-oversubscribed IPO, combining fresh equity and offer-for-sale; the Truenat point-of-care molecular diagnostics platform company listed on NSE/BSE on August 17 with a 21.44% premium at ₹980 per share, backed by Temasek and Motilal Oswal PE.
implication: Mixed IPO dynamics: 186.39x QIB over-subscription vs. 12.96x retail demand reflects strong institutional conviction in POC diagnostics valuations; OFS-heavy structure (79% of total) limited fresh capital availability for expansion-R&D and Centre of Excellence scaling contingent on working capital and operational cashflows.
detail: The IPO comprised 24.8 lakh shares (₹200 cr) at fresh issuance and 91.66 lakh shares (₹739.7 cr) offer-for-sale by existing shareholders including Exxora Trading LLP (promoter holding 41.23%), Dr. Chandrasekhar Bhaskaran Nair (promoter), India Business Excellence Fund III (Motilal Oswal-backed, 12.66%), and V Sciences Investments (Temasek-backed, 8.93%). The issue was priced at ₹807/share (upper band). Anchor allocation (Aug 7) raised ₹281.5 cr from 33 institutional investors, including Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Mirae, Nippon India MF, ICICI Prudential, Kotak MF, Tata MF, WhiteOak, and Bajaj/HDFC Life Insurance. Public subscription opened Aug 10–12 with allotment finalized Aug 13. Listing occurred Aug 17 on NSE and BSE at ₹980/share. QIB portion: 186.39x; NII: 49.80x; Retail: 12.96x.

structure.consideration: ₹939.696 cr aggregate offer value; Fresh issue: ₹200.12 cr (24.8 lakh shares @ ₹807/share); Offer-for-sale: ₹739.57 cr (91.66 lakh shares @ ₹807/share). Anchor book: ₹281.5 cr (34.87 lakh shares @ ₹807/share, Aug 7, 2026).
conditions: Book-built offer structure with SEBI-prescribed 50% QIB reservation, 15% NII, 35% retail quota
Anchor investment lock-in per SEBI regulations
Regulatory approval from BSE/NSE for listing
FEMA compliance for foreign anchor investor participation (Temasek, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Mirae, etc.)
No material adverse change in company operations or regulatory status between pricing and listing
Successful completion of red herring prospectus filing and SEBI comment resolution
approvals: SEBI approval of Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) filed Aug 22, 2025; Red Herring Prospectus (RHP) filed Aug 3, 2026
BSE Designated Stock Exchange approval for listing
FEMA approval for foreign investor remittances (if required)
BSE circular confirmation of anchor allotment (Aug 7, 2026)
structure.novel: OFS-heavy structure (79% of total issue) with mixed promoter and PE exit; strong QIB over-subscription (186.39x) despite 12.96x retail demand mismatch signals institutional belief in POC diagnostics TAM offset by retail pricing sensitivity. Employee reservation (20,519 shares @ ₹731/share, ₹76 discount) embedded in main offer.

triggers.law: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) Regulations (amended 2018)
triggers.note: Truenat POC platform and assays require manufacturing license and regulatory clearance from CDSCO; novel diagnostics depend on ICMR/WHO endorsement for market penetration and government procurement eligibility.
Temasek (Singapore sovereign fund) and foreign anchor investors (Goldman, BlackRock, Mirae, IFC participation) require FEMA/RBI compliance checks.
